origin.summary: Workout 3 of the 2018 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: Two rounds of a four-movement circuit — overhead squats, ring muscle-ups, dumbbell snatches, and bar muscle-ups — with 100 double-unders buffering every movement.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2018/3 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
